ventures.name: AI Personas → Products
ventures.tagline: AI personas on Instagram and Fanvue as the first layer of a persona → physical-product stack.
ventures.summary: Started executing Oct 28: building AI personas with Instagram pages connected to Fanvue. Thesis is that physical products bridge AI personas and fans, and that persona products can use standard molds (Fleshlight-style) at ~$200 instead of per-creator casting at ~$700. Goal is a defensible, non-commoditized brand, monetized beyond content.

nextSteps.text: Launch the first persona Instagram page and Fanvue link
Define the first persona product and its standard-mold cost
Map the AI companion / AI creator landscape for where to play

ventures.name: Hands and Feet
ventures.tagline: Luxury silicone hand and foot replicas of creators — two SKUs, unpainted and painted.
ventures.summary: Process has shifted to a Polycam phone scan of the creator → 3D cast → shipped to Lisa for the production mold. Creator acquisition is the bottleneck: the cold-DM test (~30 FeetFinder creators) got one reply, so the current lean is paid placement with “node” accounts creators follow, plus walkthrough videos showing process, product and earnings. Mystique is the anchor agency; trade-show circuit planned for the next 4–6 months (OF, comic con, fitness, streaming). Pricing is being reworked so creators set their own price and earn a higher share at higher price points.

nextSteps.text: Run the scan → cast → mold workflow end to end on the first creator
Line up 2–3 node accounts and price a paid-placement test
Book the next two trade shows and build the agency target list
Decide on Lisa’s head-of-production offer and timing

ventures.summary: Most men under-eat fiber. The idea is to change how fiber is perceived through branding, campaign, form factor and intended use, borrowing the protein-shake playbook.

ventures.name: Event-Driven Arbitrage
ventures.tagline: Fast, feed-driven bets on geopolitics and commodities using own capital.
ventures.summary: News-feed tells → a few hours of calls → decide → 1–3 weeks of execution. Research must stay short; wants bets on commonplace events in corner markets, not once-in-a-generation ones.
